item.title: ‘Wuthering Heights’ Review: Margot Robbie Powers Emerald Fennell’s Maximal, Barbed-Wire Fever Dream Of Tormented Desire
item.description: The recurring knock on filmmaker Emerald Fennell (“Saltburn,” “Promising Young Woman”), in some circles at least, is that she is all vibes: a stylist with a mean streak and no substance, an empty shit-poster guilty of confrontational rage bait. Naturally, reactions to her jagged work can bristle, but the critique’s subtext often reads like skepticism toward her cinematic sincerity, a distaste that sits in the back of the throat for anything that feels like superficial incitement.
